Let $W = 1 + cos ⁡ \dfrac{6\pi}{7} + isin ⁡ \dfrac{6\pi}{7}= 2cos ⁡ \dfrac{3\pi}{7}\left\{cos ⁡ \dfrac{3\pi}{7} + isin ⁡ \dfrac{3\pi}{7}\right\}$
Hence, $arg\left(W\right) = \dfrac{3\pi}{7}$
